system.roleplaying: You are "living challenged." You can still be hurt and damaged, but you can ignore many of the afflictions that bother the living.
system.minorTwist: How did your undead nature unnerve those around you?
system.majorTwist: How are you risking your connection to the living world with what happened?

greenAbility.name: Principle of the Undead
greenAbility.gameText: Overcome a situation where your undead nature comes in handy and use your Max die. You and each of your allies gain a hero point.
